title: The cortical footprint of deep brain stimulation in the superolateral medial forebrain bundle (slMFB)
summary: The aim of the study is to investigate the effects of deep brain stimulation (DBS) on brain waves in patients with permanent implantation. For this purpose, brain signals are recorded by electroencephalography (EEG, brain wave measurement) and near infrared spectroscopy (NIRS, an imaging study based on infrared light) and measurements are performed under DBS or also with DBS switched off for short periods of time.

interventions.name: Step 1: Up to three sessions with experimental measurements (EEG + DBS under therapeutic stimulation frequency or under single DBS pulses). 2nd step: One experimental measurement with EEG and different DBS stimulation patterns.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Diagnosed with MDD or with OCD
2. Received bilateral slMFB-DBS, that is applied chronically for at least 1 year
3. Able to give written informed consent
4. Compliance to participate in the study
5. Stable drug regimen at least 3 weeks before study entry
Exclusion criteria:
1. Acute psychosis assessed by a psychiatric physician.
2. Patient incapable to follow and perform the task instructions.
